params.body:
Fixes bevinding nederland-mobiel-is-uit-de-livewire-fiche-gevallen.

Ilse, 22 September 2026: "België/Nederland Mobiel is verdwenen uit de portals." It had, and it was
worse than a missing checkbox.

`VehicleObserver` decides on `request()->nederland_mobiel_allowed` and on nothing else. The classic
sheet posts that field, a hidden `0` next to the switch. The Livewire sheet never did, because
Livewire does not post a form, so `isset(...)` was false on every save. That froze the switch in both
directions: a vehicle already listed could not be taken off, and one that was not listed could not be
put on. R P3-5.1 says a vehicle goes to Nederland Mobiel when the dealer has the link **and the
vehicle is allowed for it**; that second half was unreachable from the new sheet.

Measured on production while fixing: **128 dealers** have the link switched on and **909 vehicles**
are listed.

The checkbox is back in the portals block, where Ilse went looking for it. Nederland Mobiel is not a
row in `portals`, it is its own link on the dealer with its own flag on the vehicle, so the block now
renders for a dealer who has the link even when he has no portals at all.

The wish is written into the request just before the save that wakes the observer, exactly as the
classic sheet posts it. That the observer hangs on a form field rather than on the vehicle is the
real weakness, and it is deliberately left alone here: the same contract carries the classic sheet
and the API, and widening this fix into that would put 909 listings at risk for a tidier shape. It is
named in the finding and in a comment at both ends.

Two of the three tests fail against the component as it stands on main, with "Failed asserting that
null matches expected true": the property does not exist there.
params.title: The sheet can still reach Nederland Mobiel
